text: Mayor of Irvine
It has been my privilege to serve as your Mayor, united by a shared vision to make Irvine the Safest, Smartest, Greenest, Healthiest, and Kindest City in America.
Together, we've made remarkable progress toward that goal. Now, I ask for your vote to continue our work. Specifically, we must:
Invest in public safety to maintain our ranking as America's Safest Big City.
Expand our newly established Irvine Public Library System with new programs, enhanced services, and 100,000 additional books.
Build-out the Great Park; maintain our top-ranked Irvine park system; and add the 700-acre Gateway Preserve to our 10,000-acre Irvine Open Space Preserve.
Implement our Urban Forest Master Plan, planting another 100,000 trees.
Equip our City Hall with cost-saving solar panels and battery backup systems.
Improve mobility and reduce traffic and pollution by expanding our free, non-polluting Irvine Connect shuttle bus service throughout Irvine.
Expand our public health and social support initiatives, creating a City of Irvine Department of Health and Wellness.
Let's do all this . . . and more, while continuing to adopt balanced budgets with $100 million in reserves to guarantee the delivery of Irvine's top-notch city services.
I ask for your vote so we can continue to move forward . . . together.

Thank you!
Larry Agran
LarryAgran.com

text: Software Engineer/Businessowner
I am blessed and proud to call Irvine home. My passion for protecting Irvine’s open space, serving every resident, and planning responsibly for the future inspired me to run for Mayor.
As a software engineer, I have built my career solving problems, improving quality, and delivering results. I will bring a practical, transparent, and accountable approach to City Hall.

I serve on my neighborhood HOA Board and have volunteered on the School Site Council and English Learner Advisory Committee (ELAC) at my children’s Irvine school. These experiences have strengthened my belief that the best decisions come from listening and working together.

As Mayor, I will work collaboratively with my fellow Council members to strengthen fiscal responsibility, provide strong budget oversight, restore long-term budget stability, protect our open space, support public safety, encourage innovation, and give residents the opportunity to vote on the future of our open space.

As a husband and father, I want Irvine to remain one of the safest and best places to live, work, and raise a family by protecting our quality of life, planning responsibly, and improving mobility throughout our city.
I will lead with integrity and be a Mayor for all of Irvine.
